name: NROL-136
destination_explanation: A satellite this low sweeps across the sky in a few minutes, so a ground station only gets a short window to talk to it on each pass.
slot_a_text: Fifteenth batch of satellites for a reconnaissance satellite constellation built by SpaceX and Northrop Grumman for the National Reconnaissance Office to provide imaging and other reconnaissance capabilities.
slot_b_text: B1097 typically goes 30 days between flights, with a best of 14. On that form it should fly again around late December.

lg_slot_a_text: Fifteenth batch of satellites for a reconnaissance satellite constellation built by SpaceX and Northrop Grumman for the National Reconnaissance Office to provide imaging and other reconnaissance capabilities.
lg_slot_b_text: That was B1097's 14th flight in 15 months. The mix: eight Starlink, two NROL, one Transporter, and three others. At its fastest it was back on the pad in 14 days.
lg_slot_c_text: That was SpaceX's 129th launch of the year, 748th all time. It works out to a launch every other day. Falcon 9 is on a 350-flight success streak. Worldwide, it was attempt number 271 of the year.
